doc.title: Jim Cullum interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007

chapter: Riverwalk radio show and Porgy and Bess
title: Effect of the Riverwalk radio show on his life
summary: Cullum says the radio show made life fuller and busier and is tiring.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Yeah. As they should be. Interesting. The “Live at the Landing” thing, has that made a huge difference in your life would you say?

Well it’s made — it has made life more active and more full and it’s already full and busy and this just is another activity. However, it’s something that I wanted to do and have pursued with some vigor to get it to go. But yeah, it is not for the faint of heart this whole thing, I don’t believe. You know you’ve got to be — because it wears you out. It’s a lot going on.
